Quality Control: Inspect the produced parts using precision measuring tools, such as calipers and micrometers, to verify they meet required specifications and tolerances. Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues or malfunctions with the equipment and dies during production to minimize downtime. Maintenance: Perform routine maintenance on dies and equipment to identify potential problems and coordinate repairs through the tool room when needed. Safety & Housekeeping: Maintain a clean and safe work environment, ensuring all safety protocols are followed. Collaboration: Work with machine operators to ensure the correct setup and ongoing operation of the machinery. Attention to Detail: Crucial for ensuring proper die setup and high-quality part production.
